comment: She is so unclear about what her expectations are for projects and assignments. Her pop quizzes are very hear. She is one of my least favorite professors at UofR because she is rude and doesn't act like she is interested/cares about her students doing well. She's never prepared for class either

Professor was always unclear with her expectations and grading criteria. She also had favorites in the class and only taught to them. If you sought help outside of class, she would be condescending and make you feel dumb for not understanding the material during lecture.
Nice, but she makes little to no sense, along with her quizzes+tests. Very confusing person, vague in directions, beware!!
She is the best!! Make you come to class though, missing one class really messed me up for a bit, but I caught back up with some help.
One of my favorite professors at University of Richmond!
You can tell that she loves what she does and she is very passionate about her work! Great professor!

Professor Klinker is always there for you if you need help. If you don't understand something in class, don't hesitate to ask her for some help after class. She's very funny and sometimes brings in foodtreats to class!

Some people get intimidated by Prof. Klinker's teaching style because she does little teaching. Instead she attempts to guide students toward the right answer, not walk them through every step until they get there. Good class for independent learners. Will help you if you ask for it. Overall, a good professor.

Class is pretty easy but make sure you participate in class. I liked the subject but was disappointed with the lack of teaching and she can be ridiculous with grading. Some of her comments are unnecessary to the class and overall, not a great teacher.
